headline: Anthropic and Blackstone bet on AI implementation as the next trillion-dollar business, while OpenAI releases GPT-Red for safer models
tldr: Today's AI news is dominated by significant developments in AI implementation, safety, and new models. Anthropic and Blackstone are betting on AI implementation as the next big thing, with the launch of Ode. OpenAI has released GPT-Red, an LLM super-hacker designed to make its models safer. Additionally, there are updates on new AI models, features, and industry partnerships, as well as discussions on AI regulation and ethics.

new_models.title: Applied Computing wants to give oil and gas operators an AI model for the entire plant
new_models.summary: Applied Computing has raised $20M to build a foundation AI model for the oil, gas, and petrochemical industry.
new_models.why_it_matters: This development could lead to increased efficiency and safety in the oil and gas industry through the use of AI.

new_models.title: Meet GPT-Red: an LLM super-hacker OpenAI built to make its models safer
new_models.summary: OpenAI has built GPT-Red, an LLM super-hacker that helps its models boost their defenses against cyberattacks.
new_models.why_it_matters: GPT-Red is a significant development in AI safety, as it can help protect models from potential threats and improve their overall security.

new_models.title: NVIDIA Introduces New Jetson Thor Computers to Advance Mainstream Robotics and Edge AI
new_models.summary: NVIDIA has introduced the T3000 and T2000, new modular computers designed for mainstream robotics and edge AI.
new_models.why_it_matters: These new computers could enable more widespread adoption of robotics and edge AI in various industries, leading to increased efficiency and innovation.
